author: Unity
description:
In Unity 6, you can publish web games to Unity Play directly from the Editor. This makes testing your builds in the browser much faster. Simply open the build profiles window and select Web as your platform. 

#Unity3D #GameDev #UnityTips #UnityLearn
title: Publish web games to Unity Play

author: Unity
description:
Baking lighting across multiple scenes usually means opening each one, waiting for the bake, and checking the same camera angles over and over. With Unity CLI, you can turn that whole routine into a single command you run from the terminal.

In this video, we'll explore a few of Unity CLI's built-in commands and show you how to write your own custom command in just a few lines of C#. Then we'll combine them into a workflow that bakes three scenes (lightmaps, light probes, reflection probes, and environment lighting). For each scene, it captures consistent camera views and builds an HTML contact sheet.

You'll learn how to:
✅ Connect to a running Unity Editor and browse its available commands
✅ Run built-in commands like lighting bakes and game view captures from the terminal
✅ Write a custom command using a static method and the CLI command attribute
✅ Chain commands into a repeatable bake-and-review workflow that's easy to call from scripts or AI agents.

🔗 Download the example scrip
title: Light baking with Unity CLI
